guides.definition: Groups collection values under keys produced by a Lodash iteratee. Requires Lodash in the active Node.js project; Hypershell does not install it.

parameters.name: iteratee
parameters.description: Function returning a group key for each value.

examples.title: Group users by role
examples.code:
import groupBy from "lodash/groupBy.js";

const grouped = groupBy(users, user => user.role);
examples.explanation: A focused per-method import makes the dependency visible and can reduce unnecessary bundled code.

guides.definition: Creates a function that delays invocation until calls have paused. Requires Lodash in the active Node.js project; Hypershell does not install it.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Function invoked after the quiet period.

parameters.name: waitMilliseconds
parameters.description: Delay after the most recent call.

examples.title: Debounce a search request
examples.code:
import debounce from "lodash/debounce.js";

const searchLater = debounce(query => search(query), 250);
examples.explanation: Debouncing is useful for bursty UI input; call cancel or flush during lifecycle cleanup when pending work matters.

guides.definition: Recursively merges an override object into a fresh configuration object. Requires Lodash in the active Node.js project; Hypershell does not install it.

examples.title: Merge nested settings
examples.code:
import merge from "lodash/merge.js";

const config = merge({}, defaults, userSettings);
examples.explanation: Starting with an empty object avoids mutating the defaults object; arrays still follow Lodash merge semantics and may need a customizer.
